decisions.reason: As the flagship transactional email service promoted on the home page, it is central to the firm's strategic direction and likely meets or exceeds aspirations, so it is kept.
Its dedicated website page and fit with the firm's electronic document workflow strategy suggest performance is acceptable relative to aspirations, and organizational slack allows continued support.
Although only mentioned on the website, it builds on the established offer and serves persistent fax-to-email conversion needs in German business and public sectors, so it is kept within slack.
As a feature close to the established fax offer, it is likely retained to preserve core service quality, though its low prominence raises some risk of being folded into the core rather than dropped.
Email sandbox threat protection supports the firm's secure messaging value proposition and is likely kept as a complementary security offering under organizational slack.
